overview.description: The MAX Auto Industry - 3x Inverse Leveraged ETN (CARD) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the Prime Auto Industry index. The fund is an exchange-traded note that tracks -3x the daily price movements of an index consisting of US-listed companies in the broader auto industry ecosystem. The index selects equities by market-cap and weights the resulting portfolio by liquidity. CARD was launched on Jun 30, 2023 and is issued by Max.
